name: Chop Bot
tagline: One morning brief for email, calendar and X replies, with every draft approved by you
description: Each day it gathers your email, your calendar and your X conversations and compresses them into one short brief. The replies you owe get drafted and parked in Gmail drafts for your approval, and long-silent threads get a nudge so they do not slip away. Nothing goes out until you say yes.
author: CaliLumberJack
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
